name: Room & Board
description: A shared room, a hot meal, and a safe night's sleep.

name: Private Room & Board
description: A private room with a locked door and a meal.

name: Stable & Feed
description: A dry stall and feed for a horse or mule.

name: Medical Healing
description: A healer's care for wounds and lingering hurts.

name: Alchemist
description: Mixes reagents, identifies potions, and keeps a careful ledger.

name: Animal Handler
description: Calms, feeds, and drives horses and pack animals.

name: Blacksmith
description: Repairs metal gear and shoes horses at a portable forge.

name: Bodyguard
description: A steady hand in a fight, hired to keep you alive.

name: Local Guide
description: Knows the roads, tolls, and safe houses nearby.

name: Lockpick
description: Opens doors and chests that were not meant to open.

name: Navigator
description: Reads charts, stars, and coastlines to keep a party on course.

name: Sailor
description: Handles ropes, sails, and a boat in bad weather.

name: Scholar
description: Reads old languages and knows where to look things up.

name: Tracker
description: Follows trails and reads sign in wild country.

name: Trapper
description: Sets snares, skins game, and finds water.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
description: An old campaigner who has survived worse than this.
